# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (Amsterdam, Netherlands) — engineering consultancy. We build what has to work: firmware, software, and fintech at a fixed price. We also build our own arboreal robots.

Olivabot B.V. is a Dutch company in Amsterdam (KVK 94493200, VAT NL866797373B01). Fixed-price engineering for teams across the EU. No day rates. Prices are published below.

## Prices (all excluding VAT)

Olivabot prices outcomes, not hours. **There is no day rate and no hourly rate**, and no timesheets. A fee is agreed in writing for an agreed result before work starts, and it does not change because the work took longer than estimated.

- **Assessment**: a call plus a written diagnosis — what is wrong, what to do, what it will take. Yours to act on or hand to another engineer. **€500**.
- **Deep technical assessment**: for performance and data questions — profiling the hot path or mapping where customer data actually goes, delivered as a prioritised plan. **€2,500**.
- **Fixed-scope project**: working firmware or software, delivered. **€5,000–€10,000**.
- **Larger engagement**: scoped in a free call, then one fee against an agreed result. **From €10,000**.
- **Hosting and maintenance**: it stays online, patched, and backed up on an EU server. **From €150/month**.

## Services

- [Firmware and embedded](https://olivabot.com/en/services/firmware.html): C/C++ on ARM, RTOS, BLE/LoRaWAN, battery life, sensor drivers, on-device ML, and CAD for the enclosure. **€500 assessment, projects €5,000–€10,000**.
- [Fintech engineering](https://olivabot.com/en/services/fintech.html): payments, ledgers, latency and throughput, and LLM agents that run on EU servers instead of a US API. **€2,500 deep assessment, projects from €5,000**. Not a high-frequency trading shop.
- [Software for devices and data](https://olivabot.com/en/services/software.html): web apps, sensor dashboards, and computer vision on a dedicated EU server. **€5,000–€10,000** for a first version. Includes a **€500** data and privacy review (not legal advice).
- [Agricultural consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/agriculture-robotics.html): which farm robot can help now. 45-minute call + written report. **€500**.
- [EU hosting and maintenance](https://olivabot.com/en/services/hosting.html): dedicated EU server, tested backups, monitoring, security updates. **From €150/month**.

## What we do not do

No workshop, no production line, no field crew. We deliver calls, code, and design files. We do not sell harvest robots, mowers, farm machinery, or night-vision hardware, and we do not run 3D printers or assemble devices. We are not a high-frequency trading specialist, not a law firm, and not an auditor.

## Client work

- [Madglove Sense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/madglove-sense.html): motion sensing miniaturised to a finger ring, plus a hand-landmark computer-vision tool for physiotherapists, for Madglove Amsterdam BV (Nov 2024 – Jun 2026).
- [Mycosense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/mycosense.html): water, soil, and infrared monitoring with LoRaWAN probes and dashboards, for Mycofarming BV, co-funded by the Province of Noord-Holland.
- [All client work](https://olivabot.com/en/work.html)

## Our own robots

- [Gibbon Bot](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/gibbon-bot.html): arboreal robot for canopy work, field-tested in olive groves, August 2025.
- [Olivabot Vision](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/vision.html): MIT feasibility study on canopy computer vision.
- [Arboreal robots R&D](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/arboreal-robots.html)
